name: AKSynxa — Booking aate hi Google Sheet + Notify

parameters.content:
## 📥 AKSynxa → n8n (Booking Automation)

**Kaise kaam karta hai**
1. AKSynxa me koi booking confirm hoti hai
2. AKSynxa ek signed webhook POST bhejta hai (`booking.created`)
3. Ye workflow use receive karke Google Sheet me row add karta hai + ek notify HTTP call (stub) bhejta hai

**Setup**
1. Neeche wale **Webhook** node ki Production URL copy karo
2. AKSynxa admin se subscription banao:
   `POST /admin/webhooks` — `{brand, url: <n8n URL>, events: ["booking.created"]}`
   (ya AKSynxa team ko bolo, wo laga degi)
3. **Google Sheets** node me apni Sheet select karo (columns: Timestamp, Customer, Number, Service, Summary)
4. **Notify** node me `example.com` wali URL apni asli service se badlo (Telegram/WhatsApp/Slack jo chaahe)
5. Workflow ko **Active** kar do ✅

### 🔐 Signature check (optional, recommended)

AKSynxa har webhook ko sign karta hai:
`X-AKSynxa-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256(secret, body)>`

Secret tumhe subscription banate waqt mila tha. Verify karna ho to Webhook node ke baad ek Code node laga kar HMAC compare kar lo — bina sahi signature wali request reject kar do.
